view: Frontal chest radiograph, likely PA (scapulae only partially cleared from the upper lateral lung fields); L side marker present on the image right, so conventional orientation confirmed
technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration (about 9 posterior ribs above the right hemidiaphragm), no significant rotation (medial clavicular ends roughly symmetric about the spinous processes), adequate penetration (thoracic vertebral bodies visible through the heart). Post-processed image with dark collimation borders and blurred film periphery; no motion blur. Lung apices and costophrenic angles fully included.

devices.type: Lead side marker 'L' with small lead initials beneath it (external)
devices.location: Upper corner of film on the patient's left, projected over left shoulder soft tissue

devices.type: Round radiopaque disc about 1.5 cm (external marker disc or button/snap), not intrathoracic
devices.location: Patient's left shoulder/axillary soft tissue, just below the L marker and lateral to the proximal left humerus, outside the rib cage

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（疑為PA），吸氣深度足夠、無明顯旋轉、穿透度適當；影像右側（病人左側）肩部見「L」側別鉛字標記及其下方一約1.5公分之圓形外在不透光物（外部標記片或鈕扣），未見胸管、引流管或其他置入裝置。雙側肺野清晰，上、中、下肺區均未見實質浸潤、結節、肺塌陷或明確肋膜增厚，雙側肺尖及肋膈角銳利，無肋膜積液或氣胸。心臟大小與縱膈輪廓正常，氣管居中，雙側肺門形態正常；骨骼結構完整，雙側肱骨近端生長板尚未閉合（與12歲年齡相符），左橫膈下可見胃泡。整體為正常範圍之胸部X光。
